meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后,当你提出要求时,Claude 会从 claude-mem 的持久记忆时间线抓取项目全部观察记录,生成一份名为「Journey Into [项目名]」的叙述性开发史报告,包含项目起源、架构演进、关键突破、技术债务、调试故事、记忆价值与统计等章节。
howto.when: 当你说“写时间线报告”、“Journey into [项目]”、“分析项目历史”等请求时触发;需要 claude-mem 工作进程在运行且有该项目的观察记录。

say.text: 写一份我的项目时间线报告
say.note: Claude 会先确认项目名并获取时间线。
针对 tokyo 项目生成完整开发历程报告。

say.text: 分析这个项目的历史,输出完整报告
say.note: 大项目会先提示 token 消耗并征求确认。

howto.what_en: When requested, Claude pulls the full observation history from claude-mem's timeline and writes a narrative "Journey Into [Project]" report covering origins, architecture, breakthroughs, tech debt, debugging, memory ROI, and stats.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a timeline report, "Journey into [project]", "Analyze my project history", etc. Requires the claude-mem worker running and observations recorded for that project.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for my project.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the project name and fetch the timeline.
Generates the full development report for the tokyo project.

say_en.text: Analyze this project's history and output a full report.
say_en.note: For large projects it estimates token cost and asks to proceed.
